components.description: The MH Wilds teal action; Tarot uses the same family with larger padding.
components.css: .ds-tool-button{min-height:44px;padding:.65rem 1rem;border:1px solid var(--teal, #146b6e);border-radius:6px;background:var(--teal, #146b6e);color:#fff;font:600 1rem var(--font-body, 'Barlow', sans-serif);cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .15s ease;} .ds-tool-button:hover{background:#0c5254;border-color:#0c5254;} .ds-tool-button:active{background:#093e40;} .ds-tool-button:disabled{opacity:.55;cursor:wait;} .ds-tool-button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--teal, #146b6e);outline-offset:3px;} @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-tool-button{transition:none;}}

components.name: Tool ghost action
components.css: .ds-tool-ghost{min-height:44px;padding:.65rem 1rem;border:1px solid var(--teal, #146b6e);border-radius:6px;background:transparent;color:var(--teal, #146b6e);font:600 1rem var(--font-body, 'Barlow', sans-serif);cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .15s ease;} .ds-tool-ghost:active{background:#093e40;} .ds-tool-ghost:hover{background:var(--teal, #146b6e);border-color:#0c5254;color:#fff;} .ds-tool-ghost:disabled{opacity:.55;cursor:wait;} .ds-tool-ghost:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--teal, #146b6e);outline-offset:3px;} @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-tool-ghost{transition:none;}}

components.name: Question field
components.description: The Tarot intention field, with its label and visible focus.
components.css: .ds-question-label{display:block;margin:1.75rem 0 .5rem;color:var(--ink, #171b1b);font:600 1.125rem/1.6 var(--font-body, 'Barlow', sans-serif);}.ds-question-label span{font-weight:400;color:var(--muted, #535f5b);}.ds-question{width:100%;min-height:52px;padding:.8rem 1rem;border:1px solid var(--muted, #535f5b);border-radius:6px;background:#fffcf5;color:var(--ink, #171b1b);font:400 1.125rem/1.6 var(--font-body, 'Barlow', sans-serif);caret-color:var(--teal, #146b6e);}.ds-question::placeholder{color:var(--muted, #535f5b);opacity:1;}.ds-question:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--teal, #146b6e);outline-offset:4px;}

components.name: Photography filters
components.description: Square archive controls with an ink-filled selected state.
components.css: .ds-filters{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.5rem;}.ds-filter{appearance:none;min-height:44px;padding:.6rem 1.15rem;border:1px solid var(--ink, #171b1b);border-radius:0;background:transparent;color:var(--ink, #171b1b);font:600 1rem/1.25 var(--font-body, 'Barlow', sans-serif);cursor:pointer;transition:background 150ms ease,color 150ms ease;}.ds-filter:hover{background:var(--paper-deep, #e8dec9);}.ds-filter[aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--ink, #171b1b);color:var(--paper, #f5eddc);}.ds-filter:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--teal, #146b6e);outline-offset:5px;}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-filter{transition:none;}}

components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:28px;margin:0;padding:0;list-style:none;font:400 1.125rem/1.6 var(--font-body, 'Barlow', sans-serif);color:var(--ink, #171b1b);}.ds-nav a{display:block;position:relative;padding:5px 0;color:inherit;font-weight:600;text-decoration:none;}.ds-nav a::after{content:'';position:absolute;left:0;bottom:0;width:100%;height:3px;background:currentColor;transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:left;transition:transform 240ms var(--ease-out, cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1));}.ds-nav a:is(:hover,:focus-visible,[aria-current])::after{transform:scaleX(1);}.ds-nav a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--ink, #171b1b);outline-offset:5px;}@media(max-width:760px){.ds-nav{gap:14px 22px;font-size:1rem;}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-nav a::after{transition:none;}}

components.name: Title-frame link
components.description: The short underline is the title sequence's signature link feedback.
components.css: .ds-title-frame{padding:30px 40px 22px;background:var(--mustard, #e0b23c);color:var(--ink, #171b1b);border-bottom:3px solid var(--ink, #171b1b);}.ds-title-frame h2{margin:0;font:400 clamp(3.3rem,6.7vw,6rem)/1.05 var(--font-display, 'Anton', sans-serif);letter-spacing:-.025em;text-transform:uppercase;}.ds-title-frame a{position:relative;color:inherit;text-decoration:none;}.ds-title-frame a::after{content:'';position:absolute;left:0;bottom:-5px;width:.8em;height:4px;background:currentColor;transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:left;transition:transform 240ms var(--ease-out, cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1));}.ds-title-frame a:is(:hover,:focus-visible)::after{transform:scaleX(1);}.ds-title-frame a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--ink, #171b1b);outline-offset:5px;}@media(max-width:760px){.ds-title-frame{padding:28px 24px 24px;}.ds-title-frame h2{font-size:4rem;}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-title-frame a::after{transition:none;}}

narrative.overview:
The Title Sequence is a personal anthology told through large condensed titles, decisive color fields and dark structural seams. Mustard, deep teal and brick carry the expressive surfaces; pale paper gives work, writing and personal identity a common ground.

The interior pages lower the volume for reading and operation. Anton names destinations and sections; Barlow carries paragraphs, controls and data. The world is crisp and predominantly flat, with no ornamental grain or glow. Existing artwork supplies the project imagery; the photography archive leads with the owner's photographs and distinguishes actual film from digital captures.
keyCharacteristics: Large Anton titles paired with readable Barlow text.
Mustard, deep teal and brick fields on pale paper.
Dark structural seams and square editorial frames.
Quiet reading measures and restrained tool controls.
Short underline feedback with visible keyboard focus.

rules.name: The Color Field Rule
rules.body: Use the strong palette as substantial title fields or meaningful interface states. Keep reading surfaces on pale paper.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Anton names the place; Barlow carries the reading and operation. Article and project body headings use Barlow, while photographic stories retain their existing Anton section headings.

rules.name: The Functional Depth Rule
rules.body: Editorial frames have no shadows. Preserve the soft Tarot deck shadow and the MH Wilds dialog shadow only for their existing physical-card and overlay roles.

dos: Do use the shared palette and self-hosted Anton/Barlow pairing for new screen surfaces.
Do retain dark seams for major editorial divisions and lighter rules for repeated reading or data rows.
Do give article and project prose a readable measure and allow the mobile layout to become a clear vertical sequence.
Do preserve visible focus, selected-state text or semantics, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do show supplied artwork honestly and keep personal photography uncropped; record image origins in assets/ASSET-SOURCES.md.
Do use quieter Barlow controls and the existing tool variants within Tarot and MH Wilds.
donts: Don't add ornamental grain, glow, gradients or texture simulations to the title-sequence world.
Don't turn the entire interface into rounded floating cards; the editorial surfaces are flat and square.
Don't use Anton for long paragraphs or dense tool data.
Don't make content depend on an entrance animation or hide destinations behind motion.
Don't fabricate personal photographs, portraits or visual evidence of work.
Don't apply this system to the excluded budget app or replace the CV's dedicated print treatment.
